sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "life_areas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (color_hex GLOB '#[0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f]'), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_default IN (0, 1)), "is_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_visible IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sort_order >= 0), "archived_at" INTEGER);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_life_areas_active_name ON life_areas (name COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE archived_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_life_areas_default_active ON life_areas (is_default) WHERE is_default = 1 AND archived_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mission_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES life_areas(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "description" TEXT, "mission_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mission_type IN ('PRIMARY', 'SECONDARY', 'ERRAND', 'DAILY', 'RECURRING', 'EVENT', 'CHALLENGE', 'CUSTOM')), "importance" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' CHECK (importance IN ('MINOR', 'NORMAL', 'IMPORTANT', 'VERY_IMPORTANT', 'CRITICAL')), "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' CHECK (priority IN ('LOW', 'NORMAL', 'HIGH', 'URGENT')), "difficulty" TEXT CHECK (difficulty IS NULL OR difficulty IN ('EASY', 'MEDIUM', 'HARD')), "is_required" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_required IN (0, 1)), "xp_reward" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (xp_reward >= 0), "estimated_minutes" INTEGER CHECK (estimated_minutes IS NULL OR estimated_minutes > 0), "budget_minor" INTEGER CHECK (budget_minor IS NULL OR budget_minor >= 0), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mission_template_objectives" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mission_templates(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "description" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 240), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (row_version >= 1), UNIQUE(template_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES mission_templates(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (frequency IN ('DAILY', 'WEEKLY', 'SPECIFIC_DAYS', 'EVERY_N_DAYS')), "interval_value" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (interval_value >= 1), "weekdays_mask" INTEGER, "local_time_minutes" INTEGER CHECK (local_time_minutes IS NULL OR local_time_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(start_date) = 10 AND start_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(start_date) IS NOT NULL AND date(start_date) = start_date), "end_date" TEXT CHECK (end_date IS NULL OR(length(end_date) = 10 AND end_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(end_date) IS NOT NULL AND date(end_date) = end_date AND end_date >= start_date)), "timezone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_generated_on" TEXT CHECK (last_generated_on IS NULL OR(length(last_generated_on) = 10 AND last_generated_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(last_generated_on) IS NOT NULL AND date(last_generated_on) = last_generated_on)), CHECK((frequency = 'SPECIFIC_DAYS' AND weekdays_mask BETWEEN 1 AND 127)OR(frequency <> 'SPECIFIC_DAYS' AND weekdays_mask IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "missions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "template_id" TEXT REFERENCES mission_templates(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES life_areas(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "description" TEXT, "mission_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mission_type IN ('PRIMARY', 'SECONDARY', 'ERRAND', 'DAILY', 'RECURRING', 'EVENT', 'CHALLENGE', 'CUSTOM')), "importance" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' CHECK (importance IN ('MINOR', 'NORMAL', 'IMPORTANT', 'VERY_IMPORTANT', 'CRITICAL')), "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' CHECK (priority IN ('LOW', 'NORMAL', 'HIGH', 'URGENT')), "difficulty" TEXT CHECK (difficulty IS NULL OR difficulty IN ('EASY', 'MEDIUM', 'HARD')), "is_required" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_required IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED', 'AVAILABLE', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'RESCHEDULED', 'EXPIRED', 'ABANDONED', 'CANCELLED', 'PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED')), "scheduled_at" INTEGER, "available_from" INTEGER, "expires_at" INTEGER, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER CHECK (estimated_minutes IS NULL OR estimated_minutes > 0), "budget_minor" INTEGER CHECK (budget_minor IS NULL OR budget_minor >= 0), "xp_planned" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (xp_planned >= 0), "actual_result" TEXT, "convenience_rating" TEXT CHECK (convenience_rating IS NULL OR convenience_rating IN ('TOTALLY_WORTH_IT', 'WORTH_IT_BUT_COSTLY', 'PARTIALLY_WORTH_IT', 'BARELY_WORTH_IT', 'WOULD_NOT_REPEAT')), "completed_at" INTEGER, "archived_at" INTEGER, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (row_version >= 1), CHECK((status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)OR(status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') AND completed_at IS NULL)), CHECK(available_from IS NULL OR scheduled_at IS NULL OR available_from <= scheduled_at), CHECK(scheduled_at IS NULL OR expires_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at <= expires_at), CHECK(available_from IS NULL OR expires_at IS NULL OR available_from <= expires_at));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_occurrence ON missions (template_id, scheduled_at) WHERE template_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_missions_status_date ON missions (status, scheduled_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_missions_area_date ON missions (area_id, scheduled_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mission_objectives" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "description" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 240), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 0), "completed_at" INTEGER, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(mission_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "time_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('TIMER', 'MANUAL')), "segment_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (segment_type IN ('WORK', 'BREAK')), "started_at" INTEGER, "ended_at" INTEGER, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (duration_seconds >= 0), "note" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK(ended_at IS NULL OR started_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at));
CREATE INDEX idx_time_mission_start ON time_entries (mission_id, started_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_time_open_timer_work ON time_entries (mission_id) WHERE source = 'TIMER' AND segment_type = 'WORK' AND ended_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mission_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN ('CREATED', 'UPDATED', 'AVAILABLE', 'STARTED', 'PAUSED', 'RESUMED', 'RESCHEDULED', 'EXPIRED', 'ABANDONED', 'CANCELLED', 'PARTIALLY_COMPLETED', 'COMPLETED', 'CORRECTED', 'ARCHIVED')), "from_status" TEXT CHECK (from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED', 'AVAILABLE', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'RESCHEDULED', 'EXPIRED', 'ABANDONED', 'CANCELLED', 'PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED')), "to_status" TEXT CHECK (to_status IS NULL OR to_status IN ('DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED', 'AVAILABLE', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'RESCHEDULED', 'EXPIRED', 'ABANDONED', 'CANCELLED', 'PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED')), "reason" TEXT, "snapshot_json" TEXT, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_event_mission_time ON mission_events (mission_id, occurred_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_schedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "notification_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (notification_type IN ('EARLY', 'PREPARATION', 'START', 'FOLLOW_UP', 'CRITICAL')), "notify_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'SCHEDULED', 'FIRED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED')), "system_notification_id" INTEGER, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(mission_id, notification_type, notify_at));
CREATE INDEX idx_notification_due ON notification_schedules (status, notify_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "mission_id" TEXT REFERENCES missions(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "related_transaction_id" TEXT REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "transaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transaction_type IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE', 'REFUND', 'ADJUSTMENT_CREDIT', 'ADJUSTMENT_DEBIT')), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0), "payment_method" TEXT CHECK (payment_method IS NULL OR payment_method IN ('CASH', 'BANK', 'WALLET')), "category" TEXT, "note" TEXT, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reversed_at" INTEGER CHECK (reversed_at IS NULL OR reversed_at >= occurred_at));
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_date_type ON transactions (occurred_at, transaction_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_mission ON transactions (mission_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_related ON transactions (related_transaction_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "savings_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "target_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_minor > 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACHIEVED', 'PAUSED', 'ARCHIVED')), "due_date" TEXT CHECK (due_date IS NULL OR(length(due_date) = 10 AND due_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(due_date) IS NOT NULL AND date(due_date) = due_date)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES savings_goals(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('RESERVE', 'RELEASE')), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0), "note" TEXT, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_goal_time ON goal_allocations (goal_id, occurred_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "origin_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin_type IN ('MANUAL', 'MISSION', 'TRANSACTION', 'SYSTEM')), "mission_id" TEXT REFERENCES missions(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "body" TEXT, "mood" TEXT CHECK (mood IS NULL OR mood IN ('FOCUSED', 'NORMAL', 'TIRED')), "mood_detail" TEXT CHECK (mood_detail IS NULL OR mood_detail IN ('HAPPY', 'MOTIVATED', 'FOCUSED', 'CALM', 'NORMAL', 'ANXIOUS', 'SAD', 'TIRED')), "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_private IN (0, 1)), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX idx_journal_time ON journal_entries (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_journal_mission ON journal_entries (mission_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_journal_transaction ON journal_entries (transaction_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "journal_entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind = 'PHOTO'), "storage_name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mime_type IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')), "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_length > 0), "cipher_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(cipher_sha256) = 64 AND cipher_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "width_px" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (width_px > 0), "height_px" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (height_px > 0), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER, UNIQUE(journal_entry_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "xp_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES life_areas(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "mission_id" TEXT REFERENCES missions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "journal_entry_id" TEXT REFERENCES journal_entries(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('MISSION', 'JOURNAL', 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT')), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount <> 0), "reason" TEXT, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK(source_type = 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT' OR amount > 0), CHECK(source_type <> 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT' OR length(trim(reason)) > 0));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_xp_mission ON xp_transactions (mission_id) WHERE source_type = 'MISSION'
CREATE INDEX idx_xp_area_time ON xp_transactions (area_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_xp_time ON xp_transactions (occurred_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "title_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT, "title_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (title_kind IN ('PERMANENT', 'DYNAMIC', 'TEMPORARY')), "rule_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "threshold" INTEGER CHECK (threshold IS NULL OR threshold >= 0), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "title_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES title_definitions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'EARNED')), "activated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deactivated_at" INTEGER CHECK (deactivated_at IS NULL OR deactivated_at >= activated_at), "best_streak" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (best_streak >= 0), "recovery_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (recovery_count >= 0));
CREATE INDEX idx_title_history_time ON title_history (title_id, activated_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_title_history_current ON title_history (title_id) WHERE deactivated_at IS NULL AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EARNED')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "theme_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_color" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (primary_color GLOB '#[0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f]'), "large_text" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (large_text IN (0, 1)), "reduce_motion" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reduce_motion IN (0, 1)), "high_contrast" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (high_contrast IN (0, 1)), "hide_amounts" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (hide_amounts IN (0, 1)), "mission_notifications" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mission_notifications IN (0, 1)), "daily_summary" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (daily_summary IN (0, 1)), "sound_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sound_enabled IN (0, 1)), "auto_lock_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (auto_lock_minutes >= 0), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schema_metadata" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
